## Syllabus

Adapt this section to describe the topics and activities covered by your course.

- Introduction to the course subject and key concepts
- Practical exercises, demonstrations, and discussions
- Methods, tools, and resources relevant to the course
- Opportunities to apply the material independently or collaboratively

## Learning outcomes

After completing this course, participants should be able to:

- Describe the main concepts covered in the course.
- Apply relevant methods and tools to practical tasks.
- Evaluate results and communicate their conclusions.
- Identify appropriate resources for further learning.
